_comment: Per-(method/dataset/error_class) minimum recall floors for the coverage regression gate. Floors are seeded from a verified full-RAHA run that reproduces the committed aggregate F1 (hospital 0.7926, flights 0.0000, beers 0.0391). They lock in current strong coverage so the breadth push cannot silently regress it. Raise flights/beers floors as detectors land. Enforced by dataforge.bench.check_coverage_regression against a `dataforge bench --quick` run.
